sources.title: Liberia Visa on Arrival
sources.officialityEvidence: The Liberia Immigration Service operates the current application and border-issuance portal and expressly assigns the route according to mission availability in the traveller's country.
sources.supportingExcerpt: If there is a Liberian embassy in your country, you are required to apply for your visa directly at the embassy.

conditional.title: Liberia visa issuance depends on mission availability
conditional.summary: Visa-liable visitors use advance mission issuance when a Liberian embassy is available in their country; otherwise they may pre-apply and collect the visa sticker at Roberts International Airport.
conditions: When a Liberian embassy exists in the traveller's country, the official portal requires application through that embassy before travel.
When no Liberian embassy exists in the traveller's country, the traveller may seek advance approval and collect a physical visa sticker at Roberts International Airport.
The airport route is limited to Roberts International Airport and remains subject to application approval and final border checks.
The condition depends on the traveller's country and available mission, not solely on passport nationality, so it does not change ranking status.
